answers.why: The rebellious people demand that the Holy One of Israel cease confronting them.
The Holy One of Israel addresses the people who despise his word and trust oppression.
The Holy One of Israel offers salvation to the people who refuse returning and rest.
The people approach the LORD's mountain to worship Israel's Rock.
The Holy One of Israel is the nation's God whom those seeking Egyptian help neglect.
Hezekiah commands Judah and Jerusalem to worship before this altar.
Hezekiah invokes the God of Israel while praying for deliverance from Assyria.
The LORD God of Israel responds to Hezekiah's prayer against Assyria's king.
Sennacherib's reproach against Jerusalem challenges the nation's Holy One.
Jacob and Israel name the people complaining that God overlooks their cause.
Israel is God's chosen servant, Abraham's offspring gathered from the ends of the earth.
The Holy One of Israel promises to redeem the people addressed as Jacob and Israel.
The people will rejoice in the LORD and glory in their Holy One.
The God of Israel promises not to forsake the poor and needy seeking water.
The Holy One of Israel transforms the wilderness so the people recognize his work.
